verdict.rationale: Runpod's public pricing page (runpod.io/pricing) lists GPU instances with published hourly rates, such as the B300 at $8.99/hr. It offers Community and Secure Cloud views with per-hour and per-second toggles, and Pod pricing docs confirm per-second self-serve billing. Sales contact is required only for reserved capacity and contract pricing, not for on-demand rates. Missing for 10: evidence that every GPU type is listed with a price (only one GPU's rate is quoted), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the pricing page's completeness.
